name: Air Cycle Machine
function: Cools and expands bleed air in the air-conditioning pack to supply conditioned air to the cabin.
inspection_checklist: Check pack outlet temperature trend|Inspect ACM for oil traces and abnormal noise|Check inlet/outlet ducts and clamps|Verify bearing free rotation

name: Cabin Pressure Controller
function: Controls the outflow valve to keep cabin altitude and rate of change within limits.
inspection_checklist: Read controller BITE / fault history|Check outflow valve operation in manual mode|Inspect static ports and sensing lines|Run pressurization functional test

name: Integrated Drive Generator (IDG)
function: Engine-driven generator that supplies constant-frequency AC power.
inspection_checklist: Check IDG oil level sight glass|Inspect oil filter differential pressure indicator|Check for oil leaks at mounting flange|Verify disconnect mechanism condition

name: Main Battery (Ni-Cd)
function: Provides DC power for APU start and emergency electrical supply.
inspection_checklist: Measure battery voltage on BAT display|Check vent tubes and connector|Inspect for electrolyte leakage|Perform capacity check if due

name: Engine Fire Detection Loop
function: Detects fire or overheat in the engine nacelle and triggers the fire warning.
inspection_checklist: Run fire detection system test|Measure loop resistance / continuity|Inspect loop routing and clamps|Check connectors for chafing

name: Flap Drive Actuator
function: Transmits torque from the flap power control unit to move the flap panels.
inspection_checklist: Check flap position and asymmetry log|Inspect actuator for leaks and play|Lubricate per task card|Run flap extension/retraction test

name: Elevator Aileron Computer (ELAC)
function: Fly-by-wire computer controlling elevator, aileron and stabilizer.
inspection_checklist: Read CFDS fault history|Reset computer and recheck|Check connector and rack cooling|Replace LRU if fault persists

name: Fuel Tank Booster Pump
function: Supplies pressurized fuel from the tank to the engine feed line.
inspection_checklist: Check pump low-pressure indication|Measure pump current|Inspect canister for leaks|Run pump functional test

name: Fuel Quantity Probe
function: Capacitance probe measuring fuel height in the tank for quantity indication.
inspection_checklist: Compare FQI with dipstick / magnalevel reading|Read FQIC fault history|Check probe harness continuity|Replace faulty probe

name: Engine-Driven Hydraulic Pump (Green)
function: Engine-driven pump that pressurizes the green hydraulic system.
inspection_checklist: Check system pressure on ECAM HYD page|Inspect pump case drain filter|Check for leaks at pump and lines|Verify reservoir level and pressurization

name: Hydraulic Hose & Seal Kit
function: Hoses, O-rings and seals used to repair hydraulic leaks.
inspection_checklist: Clean area and locate leak source|Check fitting torque|Replace hose / seal|Leak check under pressure and refill reservoir

name: Pitot Probe
function: Measures total pressure for airspeed; heated to prevent icing.
inspection_checklist: Inspect probe for damage and blockage|Check probe heater current|Check drain holes|Run air data test after replacement

name: Main Wheel Brake Assembly
function: Carbon multi-disc brake that decelerates the main wheels.
inspection_checklist: Measure brake wear pin length|Check brake temperature history|Inspect for hydraulic leaks at piston housing|Replace brake if pin at limit

name: Main Wheel Tyre (46x16R20)
function: Main landing gear tyre.
inspection_checklist: Check tyre pressure cold|Inspect tread depth and cuts|Check for bulges and sidewall damage|Replace and record if beyond limits

name: MLG Shock Absorber Seal Kit
function: Seals for the main landing gear shock absorber.
inspection_checklist: Measure shock strut extension|Check for fluid leaks at chrome|Service nitrogen / oil per chart|Replace seals if leaking

name: Landing Gear Proximity Sensor
function: Detects gear up/down-lock and door positions for the LGCIU.
inspection_checklist: Read LGCIU fault history|Measure sensor target gap|Check harness and connector|Run gear retraction test on jacks

name: Angle-of-Attack Sensor
function: Measures the aircraft angle of attack for flight controls and protections.
inspection_checklist: Inspect vane for damage and free movement|Check heater operation|Read ADIRU fault history|Run AOA test after replacement

name: ADIRU
function: Air data and inertial reference unit supplying attitude, heading, speed and altitude.
inspection_checklist: Read BITE / CFDS fault history|Check alignment and IR status|Inspect connector and rack|Replace LRU and run alignment

name: Weather Radar Transceiver
function: Transmits and receives radar signals to display weather ahead of the aircraft.
inspection_checklist: Run radar self-test|Inspect radome and waveguide|Check antenna drive|Replace transceiver if test fails

name: Bleed Pressure Regulating Valve
function: Regulates engine bleed air pressure supplied to the pneumatic system.
inspection_checklist: Check bleed pressure and temperature on ECAM|Inspect valve and sense lines|Check precooler for blockage|Run bleed system test

name: APU Starter Motor
function: Electric motor that cranks the APU during start.
inspection_checklist: Check battery voltage before start|Inspect starter brushes / connector|Check start sequence on ECB|Replace starter if no rotation

name: APU Fuel Control Unit
function: Meters fuel to the APU during start and operation.
inspection_checklist: Read APU ECB fault history|Check fuel supply pressure|Inspect EGT thermocouples|Replace FCU if overtemp repeats

name: Door Proximity Sensor
function: Detects door closed / locked status for the door warning system.
inspection_checklist: Check door indication on ECAM DOOR page|Measure sensor target gap|Inspect harness|Adjust or replace sensor

name: Corrosion Inhibitor & Repair Kit
function: Materials for removing corrosion and restoring protective treatment.
inspection_checklist: Remove paint and assess corrosion depth|Blend out within limits|Apply surface treatment and primer|Record and report if beyond limits

name: Nose Radome
function: Composite nose cover protecting the weather radar antenna.
inspection_checklist: Inspect for impact, cracks and delamination|Tap test damaged area|Check lightning strips|Repair or replace

name: Fan Blade (CFM56-5B)
function: Fan blade that produces most of the engine thrust.
inspection_checklist: Inspect blades for nicks, dents and cracks|Check blend limits|Check fan rotation for rubbing|Replace / blend and balance

name: HPT Blade Set (CFM56-5B)
function: High-pressure turbine blades driving the high-pressure compressor.
inspection_checklist: Review EGT margin trend|Borescope HPT stage 1 blades|Check for burn and coating loss|Plan engine shop visit if beyond limits

name: Fuel Metering Unit (FMU)
function: Meters fuel flow to the combustor as commanded by the FADEC.
inspection_checklist: Read FADEC fault history|Check fuel flow transmitter|Inspect FMU connectors|Replace FMU and run engine test

name: Oil Pressure Transmitter
function: Measures engine oil pressure for cockpit indication.
inspection_checklist: Compare indication with direct gauge|Check transmitter connector|Inspect sense line for leaks|Replace transmitter

name: Engine Oil Filter Element
function: Removes contaminants from the engine lubrication oil.
maintenance_interval: Replace every C-Check or on clog
inspection_checklist: Check clog indicator|Remove filter and inspect debris|Send debris for analysis if found|Install new element and leak check

name: Engine Oil Seal Kit
function: Seals and gaskets for oil system leak repair.
inspection_checklist: Clean area and locate leak|Check oil consumption trend|Replace seal / gasket|Ground run and leak check
